# Health & Hygiene Report 0.1.11

## AI settings and model updates

- Renames the main navigation to **Settings**, with separate **Service status** and **AI settings** sections.
- Shows the active shared AI primary and fallback models in AI settings, with a link to edit them in the Owner Admin Portal.
- Notifies the user when the shared AI model configuration changes. Acknowledging the notice automatically tests the AI service on that computer.
- Keeps AI model administration and fallback order in the Owner Admin Portal.

Existing projects and application data are preserved. The application checks the signed stable update manifest at startup; users can also check manually from **About**.
